Subject: Quick clarifications on SCIM mapping + SAML flows before kickoff

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks again for the kickoff yesterday — QuantumEdge is excited to move forward. Before we start exchanging metadata and samples with our Identity team, two quick clarifications so we scope the work and evidence correctly: 

1) For SCIM, does Redwood support PATCH (RFC7644) for attribute-level updates and does the /Users endpoint accept bulk PATCH or only per-resource operations?

2) Do you provide both IdP-initiated and SP-initiated SSO URLs in the metadata? Our security team requires explicit confirmation we can do SP-initiated flows while retaining IdP-initiated fallback.

3) RBAC: we need a mapping template from our group names (QE_Admins, QE_Developers, QE_Viewers) to Redwood roles. Can you share the admin role export or matrix?

If you can send a sample SCIM payload (just one user) and the SAML metadata file, we can have our SREs verify attribute assertions and transform rules.

Best,
Alan

Subject: Re: Quick clarifications on SCIM mapping + SAML flows before kickoff

Hi Alan — great questions, answered inline below. I attached the files you asked for.

1) SCIM PATCH/bulk: Redwood supports RFC7644 PATCH for per-user attribute updates and supports bulk operations via the /Bulk endpoint for create/update/delete batches. For your use-case we recommend PATCH for delta syncs and the Bulk endpoint for initial population. Our SCIM implementation also supports filtering and changelog-based incremental syncs (via etag/lastModified).

2) SAML flows: the metadata bundle we attached includes both IdP-initiated and SP-initiated ACS endpoints. If you prefer explicit separate URLs we can provide a small bundle that splits them out. We also support signed assertions using SHA256 and encrypted NameID if required.

3) RBAC mapping: attached is the admin role matrix (redwood_admin_role_matrix.pdf) with suggested mappings from common directory groups to Redwood roles (OrgAdmin, AppAdmin, Developer, BillingViewer). You can customize the role-to-permission mapping in the Console and push role assignments via SCIM group membership syncs.

Attachment list: redwood_scim_mapping_v3.csv (SCIM attribute mapping), redwood_saml_metadata.xml (SAML metadata), qe_scim_sample_payload.json (sample SCIM user payload), redwood_admin_role_matrix.pdf

Next steps: once your team reviews the mapping, we'll schedule a 30-minute joint session with our Identity engineers to walk through provisioning rules and test an SP-initiated login. How is your calendar next Tuesday morning (PDT)?

Thanks,
Kimberly
Kimberly Park

Kimberly / Jonas — looping in for evidence/ops notes so we can provide the right artifacts. Quick notes: 

- For SOC2 evidence, QE asked about audit log retention for admin actions. We keep immutable admin action logs for 3 years in the control plane; we can export filtered CSVs on request (audit:admin_actions.csv).

- SCIM rate limits: default per-tenant throughput is 200 requests/minute, burstable via dedicated capacity for enterprise contracts. Recommend we include rate guidance in the onboarding doc and add a short note about backoff HTTP 429 behaviors. 

- Delegated administration: we support a scoped Admin role (OrgAdmin) and also an admin delegation feature that lets OrgAdmins grant team-level Admins with limited consoles. This is managed in the Console and via SCIM group-to-role mapping.

- Action: Jonas, can you prepare a one-page SAML checklist and a short sample curl for SCIM PATCH to include in the packet?

Marissa

Subject: QuantumEdge — IAM onboarding packet & SCIM/SAML clarifications

Hi Alan / Priya — following up with the packet and a few implementation notes we discussed. Attachments included (same as listed previously). Highlights and clarifications: 

- SCIM: Supports PATCH (RFC7644), POST/PUT for create, GET with filter, /Bulk for batch ops. Delta syncs can be implemented with if-Modified-Since or by polling changes using lastModified + incremental query. We recommend PATCH for group membership changes to keep event sizes small.

- User identifier: we recommend mapping the externalDirectoryId -> external_id in Redwood and using email as secondary identifier. SCIM supports enterprise_user schema and we attach a sample payload where QE_CustomAttr is mapped to user:customAttributes.qeTenantId.

- SAML/OIDC: We support SAML 2.0 (IdP/SP initiated), signed assertions (SHA256), encrypted assertions, and metadata exchange. OIDC is supported for client credentials and authorization code flows; we also support JWT-based service tokens and introspection endpoints for long-lived integrations.

- RBAC & Delegated Admins: Attached matrix defines recommended mappings. OrgAdmin = full tenant management (billing, users, roles); AppAdmin = manage app configs; Developer = create API keys and limited console; Viewer = read-only. Delegation via SCIM group mapping and Console assignment.

- Audit & Compliance: Admin action audit logs: 3-year retention; per-request trace id included in logs. We support audit exports and can provide a signed export for compliance review.

- Rate limits & throttling: default 200 rpm for SCIM with 429 backoff headers. Dedicated plans can increase thresholds and provide SLA for provisioning latency.

Next steps: please confirm a test user and we will coordinate the joint test session. Also let us know which evidence artifacts you'd like exported for your security review (SOC2 Type II, admin_action_audit_sample.csv, SCIM_sync_log_sample.json).

Thanks,
Kimberly
